name: Unidentified B1 battle droid (Rishi Station)
description: A B1-series battle droid took part in the Defense of Rishi Station, where he was part of a reinforcement squadron sent to Rishi Station after the team of BX-series droid commandos sent there was destroyed. During the skirmish, the droids managed to drive of the remaining squadron of clone troopers stationed there, with the exception of Hevy. After a brief firefight, the clone was overpowered by the droids. However, Hevy managed to set off a tibanna bomb, killing himself and destroying the listening post. All the battle droids, including this one, were destroyed in the ensuing explosion.
